notes: The capture shows the Appearance modal open over a heavily blurred hero. The background is an animated WebGL smoke/nebula canvas whose colors follow the chosen theme (choosing Solar Ember turns it orange/fire right away). The wordmark is drawn as a particle field. The tagline rotates its verb ('write together', 'share screen', 'chat in real time') and ends in an emoji-style icon. Theme rows end in three square-edged color bars (dark/mid/light) that sit flush against the rounded dialog edge, which gives the 'mixed' shape. Theme descriptions are jokey ('Mouthwash for your bandwidth.'). Connection happens by typing a matching 4-digit code into underline-only digit boxes, with no accounts.
